spreadsheet.title: Import from Excel
spreadsheet.description: Add or change many records at once with an Excel file.
spreadsheet.step1: Download the current file: it is the model to fill in.
spreadsheet.step2: In Excel, change rows or add new ones. No code needed: it is given automatically. A row whose name already exists changes that record; a new name creates a new record.
spreadsheet.step3: Save the file, choose it below, then click “Import”.
